item: Launcher rows: a filesystem that cannot lock gets the row appended directly, not lost
summary: Before: flock failing for any reason was read as held-try-later (99), so on NFS without lockd or a FUSE/shared folder the deferred child failed too and the exit, stop and stderr rows were never written. After: with a flock that has -E, a failure other than held reaches the direct append (98); a red-without test with a flock that cannot lock.
